newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin extends fall on weaker LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin extends fall on weaker LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down 13 cents at 14.32 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, extending recent losses on the back of further weakness on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, dealers said.
"Fund managers have been selling in London for the last few days. More selling would bring prices here even lower," said a trader. But he expected strong support at 14.00-14.20 ringgit.
Turnover was 91 tonnes, against 104 on Wednesday, with buying again seen from European and Malaysian interests.
The local premium over LME widened to $115 a tonne against $20 previously.--Syed Azman (603-230 8911) ($1=2.4860 ringgit)
